subtitle: On-device AI assistant
promotional_text: Chat with AI on your phone. No Wi-Fi required. Free forever. On-device model runs locally — your conversations never leave your device.
description:
AGI runs on your device first. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone for Local Mode.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: responses can be generated by an open-source language model running on your device. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
The default model downloads once over Wi-Fi and runs locally after that. No Local Mode inference calls hit AGI Cloud. Your local conversations stay on this device and are encrypted at rest.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat.

CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE IT
AGI Cloud is in public alpha: sign in for cloud chat and web search on the free tier, with image generation on Pro and above. There are no in-app purchases in this version.

PRIVACY FIRST
We do not claim full DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Our itemised India DPDP notice is published at https://agiworkforce.com/privacy/india, and the obligations we have not met — verifiable parental consent, notice in Eighth Schedule languages, and India data residency among them — are listed at https://agiworkforce.com/trust. AI output is labelled as AI-generated, and first run names the on-device model and any cloud provider. Local Mode collects no personal data by default. Signing in to AGI Cloud uses your account email (and name, if provided by your sign-in method) to create your account. Export or delete your local data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.
Support: support@agiworkforce.com
Privacy: https://agiworkforce.com/privacy

age_rating.note: 12+ chosen to align with age-gate default (13+). 4+ may also qualify for the default experience; 12+ is the conservative choice given AI-generated text output.

data_linked_to_you.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud (public alpha). Email is required to create the account; name is collected if provided by the sign-in method.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends and any photos or files attached to them are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.

Only after sign-in: the account identifier on every authenticated cloud request, and an app-generated device UUID registered with the push token so notifications reach the right install. No advertising identifier is collected.

privacy_nutrition_labels.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud (public alpha, open to any signed-in user) collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends. Conversation content is processed by the model-provider subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors on AGI's behalf; it is never used to track the user across other companies' apps or websites.

pricing.in_app_purchase_note: Native store billing code SHIPS in the v1.2.0 binary and is deployment-gated OFF, so nothing is purchasable and in_app_purchases stays false. What ships: expo-iap 5.3.0 is a dependency and a registered config plugin in apps/mobile/app.config.js, so StoreKit 2 is linked, and src/features/billing/useMobileIap.ts drives a real purchase flow rendered by src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx. Why nothing can be bought: every purchase path requires GET /api/mobile/iap/catalog to report the catalog as enabled, and apps/web/lib/server/mobile-iap-catalog.ts only does that when MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED is set AND MOBILE_IAP_APPLE_PRODUCT_IDS_JSON maps at least one logical product key to a store ID. The gate fails closed in two branches with two different reasons: flag off or unset returns enabled:false with 'Native purchases are not enabled for this deployment.' (mobile-iap-catalog.ts:63-69), and flag on with no product key mapped returns enabled:false with 'App Store products have not been registered for this build.' (mobile-iap-catalog.ts:77-86). Our deployments are in the first branch. Either way Settings > Billing renders the inert 'Native purchases are not configured' notice in place of the whole native-purchase area — no product row, no store price, no restore action, no store sheet. The checked-in env templates ship MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED=false and define no product-ID map (apps/web/.env.example, apps/web/.env.local.example); the live flag state is a deployment setting this repo cannot prove, and is confirmed off before every submission. The rest of that screen renders the plan card; the plan-change row, whose label is 'Upgrade plan' on the free tier, 'Adjust plan' for an entitled account and 'Choose plan' otherwise (cloud-billing/index.tsx:323-329) and which is suppressed entirely on a Team or Enterprise plan in favour of a 'Workspace administration' row (:331-338) that opens agiworkforce.com/settings/team; the invoices row; for an active web-billed plan only, two static info blocks about proration and how a store top-up would be priced; and, on FIRST PAINT for every signed-in cloud-mode account, a 'Loading native purchases / Connecting securely to the App Store or Google Play' placeholder (:365-370), because nativeIap.loading starts true (useMobileIap.ts:313 with catalogLoading initialised true at :63). That placeholder carries no product, no price and no action, and is replaced by the 'not configured' notice as soon as the gated catalog answers. REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md tabulates every block on the screen with its line number so the 'no price' claim is not read wider than the native-purchase area. No App Store Connect in-app-purchase product exists for com.agiworkforce.app: MOBILE_IAP_PRODUCT_DEFINITIONS in packages/contracts/types/src/mobile-iap.ts holds logical keys only, and /api/mobile/iap/verify rejects any product it cannot resolve from that same gated catalog, so no entitlement can be granted through StoreKit while the gate is off. The plan-change CTA never shows a price or a checkout. handleUpgrade (cloud-billing/index.tsx:165-178) has three branches checked in this order: native purchase (unreachable while the gate is off); subscriptionGuard.blocked, which is true for any entitled account and for any account with a non-terminal subscription recorded against another platform (getSubscriptionOwnerGuard in src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts:56-76) and which fires a native 'Subscription managed elsewhere' alert whose second button opens agiworkforce.com/settings/billing externally (:145-163); and otherwise the in-app PaywallBottomSheet reading 'Plan changes aren't available in the app yet. Check back soon.' (or, for a lapsed paid plan, 'Billing management isn't available in the app yet. Please try again later.') with no action button. A paid reviewer account therefore takes the alert branch, not the sheet, and sees the row labelled 'Adjust plan'. FEATURES.billing is false in apps/mobile/lib/v1FeatureFlags.ts:8 so the 'Manage billing' row and the Stripe billing-portal link do not render. The description sentence 'There are no in-app purchases in this version.' stays accurate only because nothing is purchasable. Flip in_app_purchases to true, rewrite that sentence, and update REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md in the same change once real products are registered and MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED is on (in-repo claims verified 2026-08-27 against the files named here).
pricing.guideline_3_1_1_residual_risk: The earlier counts of three and then four external links were both wrong; this entry was re-derived on 2026-08-27 by grepping every openExternalUrl, openInAppBrowser, WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync and Linking.openURL call site under apps/mobile outside __tests__, and REVIEWER-NOTES-IOS.md carries the same enumeration with a file and line for each. Fourteen openExternalUrl call sites exist in production code; twelve are reachable in the iOS binary. Two are not: the Stripe billing-portal link at src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx:189 is dead behind FEATURES.billing=false, and the 'Add a member' browser branch at app/(app)/settings/workspace.tsx:134 is taken only when Platform.OS !== 'ios' (:132). Of the twelve reachable sites, eight are billing or account-management destinations and are the Guideline 3.1.1 surface: (A1) 'View invoices' opens agiworkforce.com/billing, rendered only for accounts already on a paid plan, free tier gets an inert 'No invoices yet' row (cloud-billing/index.tsx:497); (A2) 'Workspace administration' opens agiworkforce.com/settings/team on Team and Enterprise plans only (cloud-billing/index.tsx:335); (A3) 'Manage on web' on the 'Subscription managed elsewhere' alert opens agiworkforce.com/settings/billing for a web- or employer-recorded subscription, and the store's own subscription page for an Apple- or Google-recorded one (cloud-billing/index.tsx:155, URL from subscriptionManagementUrl in src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts:41-54); (A4) 'Contact Sales' opens agiworkforce.com/contact-sales?plan=... for the team/enterprise tiers only, reached from the chat paywall and not from the Billing screen because getNextUpgradeTier returns only self-serve individual tiers (PaywallBottomSheet.tsx:121, packages/contracts/types/src/billing-catalog.ts:362-375); (A5) 'View on web' opens agiworkforce.com/settings/usage for any signed-in Cloud account, sitting under copy that says a detailed usage ledger arrives once AGI Cloud billing is active — a roadmap note, and the destination shows usage rather than a purchase (src/features/settings/cloud-usage/index.tsx:131); (A6) 'Continue' on the change-email alert opens agiworkforce.com/settings/account for any signed-in Cloud account (src/features/settings/cloud-account/index.tsx:98); (A7) 'Create on web' opens agiworkforce.com/settings/team from the workspace EMPTY STATE, so it is reachable by an account with no workspace at all and not only by Team administrators (app/(app)/settings/workspace.tsx:438); (A8) 'Rename or delete this workspace on the web' opens the same URL for any account with a workspace loaded (app/(app)/settings/workspace.tsx:545). The other four reachable sites are not billing: the privacy policy and terms (src/features/settings/cloud-privacy/index.tsx:75 and :80), password recovery at agiworkforce.com/auth/reset-password (app/(auth)/reset-password.tsx:23), and the desktop-pairing safety page at agiworkforce.com/security (src/features/companion/components/PairingRiskDisclosure.tsx:23). Separately, Settings > About opens agiworkforce.com, /privacy and /terms in an in-app SFSafariViewController sheet rather than the browser (app/(app)/about.tsx:224, :230, :236), and Settings > Connectors > GitHub opens the GitHub App install OAuth start on our own host (src/features/settings/cloud-connectors/index.tsx:690). Every one of these is filtered by the allowlist in apps/mobile/lib/safeOpenURL.ts:31-43, which admits only https on agiworkforce.com and its subdomains, stripe.com, apps.apple.com and play.google.com. docs/agent-context/known-flaws.md records only the first three under MOBILE-IOS-3-1-1-EXTERNAL-LINKS and must be corrected against this entry. Whether to gate or remove any of them is a founder product/legal decision — the shipped StoreKit code is gated off and does not resolve this on its own.

export_compliance.info_plist_key: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false, declared in ios.infoPlist in apps/mobile/app.config.js
export_compliance.basis: All cryptography is Apple OS-provided: TLS via URLSession, Keychain via expo-secure-store, SecRandomCopyBytes via expo-crypto, and SQLCipher compiled with -DSQLCIPHER_CRYPTO_CC (ExpoSQLite.podspec) so its codec calls Apple CommonCrypto. No proprietary or bundled third-party cipher ships in apps/mobile. Flip to true and obtain an export-compliance code if that ever changes.

availability.territories: All App Store territories excluding: Mainland China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Crimea
